description: An HTML file containing a webpage that demonstrates event logging for various widgets and global page events using the Isomorphic SmartClient framework, including drag-and-drop widgets, event handlers, and form controls for logging.

methods.name: logEvent
methods.description: Adds a message to the event log textarea, appending the message with a newline.

methods.name: logPageEvent
methods.description: Logs a page-level event message if the 'logPageEvents' checkbox is checked.

methods.name: clearEventLog
methods.description: Clears the event log textarea and resets related input fields.

methods.name: initializeForm
methods.description: Initializes the log form, resetting event logs and checkbox states.
